messages:
julia: short brief idea: 1-page sheet that combines security controls, SLA highlights, and a deploy-mode decision strip for webinar follow-up.
sam: love it. make it scannable: header value prop, three boxes (Security, SLA, Deploy tradeoffs), 2 CTAs.
omar: security bullets: customer KMS/HSM, audit logs, data residency options. flag: legal to vet compliance wording.
julia: SLA bullets: target SLOs, latency tiers for Dedicated, fallback behavior back to hosted. add a mini flow: if SLO breached -> failover -> notify SE.
sam: benchmark callout (provisional): "95th pct latency ~90ms on Dedicated (8k ctx, KV warm); est ~$0.5 / 1k tokens" - label provisional until infra signs off.
julia: ops: downloads must create inbound leads with tag `enterprise_onepager_v2` capturing account_size, compliance_needs, requested_feature. route to AE or SE per rules.
ops-bot: routing pseudocode:
```
if lead.tag == "enterprise_onepager_v2":
  if lead.account_size >= 1000000:
    route -> enterprise_AE_queue
  elif lead.compliance == true:
    route -> solutions_engineering
  else:
    route -> growth_AE_pool
```
sam: add `requested_trial` field so sales can offer a dedicated trial quickly. include 1-line ROI for finance.
julia: timeline: copy draft by Tue, design by Thu, SFDC mapping by Fri. legal + infra signoff before publish.
ops-bot: doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1new-enterprise-onepager-draft (marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:
sam: will assemble final layout after infra posts safe numbers. thanks all :rocket:
